answer: The statutory auditors' limited-assurance engagement covers the sustainability information and Article 8 EU Taxonomy disclosures for the year ended 31 December 2025. The auditors reported no material errors, omissions or inconsistencies regarding: the ESRS-compliant process for determining reported information; the sustainability information's compliance with Article L.233-28-4 including ESRS; and compliance with Article 8 of Regulation (EU) 2020/852. Limited-assurance procedures are less extensive than reasonable-assurance procedures. The engagement does not assess the viability or quality of management, or the relevance of choices concerning action plans, targets, policies, scenarios and transition plans, and forward-looking information remains inherently uncertain.
